chain_words.nuance: has enough money to live without worry
has more money than most people
has a lot of money or possessions
has a very large amount of money

explanation: These words all describe having money, but they differ in how much money a person has, from having enough to live comfortably to being extremely rich.

usage_notes.difference: 'Rich' is the general word for having a lot of money or possessions. 'Wealthy' is more formal and suggests a very large amount of money, often built up over time.
